L105: 【37†Music Bank】 Chart winners (2026)
L106: ---
L107: The Music Bank Chart is a 【38†record chart】 established in 1998 on the South Korean 【39†KBS】 television 【40†music program】 【37†Music Bank】. Every week during its live broadcast, the show gives an award for the best-performing 【41†single】 on the South Korean chart.
L108: The show had been hosted by 【42†Park Min-ju】 and 【43†Moon Sang-min】 since October 2024,^{【44†[1]】} until they left on January 30, 2026.^{【45†[2]】} Since February 27, 2026, the show has been hosted by 【46†Bang Jee-min】 and 【47†Kim Jae-won】.^{【48†[3]】}
